title: One calendar change for the puzzle club
titleZh: 解謎社行事曆的一項變動
passage: Here’s one correction to the puzzle club calendar. This Saturday’s outdoor session is moving to the hall because the paving is being repaired. We’ll still begin at ten. The next two meetings are still on the square, so please don’t change the whole series if you saved it on your phone. The weekday puzzle session in the hall is a different group. Their notice is already on the door. On Saturday, follow our arrows from the courtyard entrance instead of joining the queue at the main desk. We’ll have puzzle sheets ready in the hall. Just bring a pencil. If you picked up an outdoor sheet earlier this week, you can use it in the hall too.
passageZh: 解謎社的行事曆有一項更正。廣場鋪面正在修繕，本週六的戶外場次改到室內會堂，還是十點開始。接下來兩次仍在廣場，所以如果你把活動存到手機裡，不要把整個系列都改掉。 平日在會堂辦的解謎活動是另一個小組，門上已有他們的公告。本週六請從中庭入口循我們的箭頭走，不要去主服務台排隊。 會堂裡會備好題紙，帶鉛筆就行。如果你本週稍早已領了戶外場次的題紙，在會堂也能用同一張。
